data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €550
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielstadt issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, dated 27 February 2026. It results in a refund of €550.00, which will be credited to your account.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment for 2025. Income tax was set at €8,990.00, but your employer already withheld €9,540.00 in wage tax, so you get €550.00 back. The money is paid into your account. Check that the figures match your tax return. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. If you agree, nothing more is needed. A tax adviser or Lohnsteuerhilfeverein can help if you are unsure.

items.title: Objection against the tax assessment (optional)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: File an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office in writing, electronically or in person only if you disagree with the assessment.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged in the normal way.
